_comment: Single source of truth for topic-tag normalization, shared across Generate-TopicList.mjs, patch-pagefind.mjs, and Generate-TopicsPage.ps1. Do not edit this comment key at runtime; it is documentation only. See topic-aliases.mjs for the full explanation of how this was built.

aliasNotes.hours: Canonical form 'hours-of-work' confirmed against patch-pagefind.mjs SECTION_INDEX_PATTERNS (/^hours.of.work$/ is an already-established section-index slug).
aliasNotes.occupational-health-and-safety: Canonical form 'ohs' confirmed against patch-pagefind.mjs SECTION_INDEX_PATTERNS (/^ohs$/ is an already-established section-index slug) — merged the long form INTO the short form, opposite direction from the other aliases, because the codebase already treats 'ohs' as canonical elsewhere.
aliasNotes.flexible-working-arrangements: Verified 15 Aug 2026: 'flexible-work' (23 files) and 'flexible-working-arrangements' (1 file) tag the identical Fair Work Act s.65 flexible-working-arrangements-request clause (specified employee, 21-day response, refusal grounds) near-verbatim across EBAs. 'flexibility' (cross-role rostering) and 'flexible-working' (1 file, loosely applied to a transition-to-retirement clause) are NOT part of this merge — kept in needsReview / left as-is respectively.
aliasNotes.workload-management: Verified 15 Aug 2026: 'workload' (3 files) and 'workload-management' (1 file, has-managers-admin-2025-2027 clause 81) share near-identical Purpose/Overtime/Safe-Staffing/Allocation structure verbatim; clause 81 itself lists synonyms:['workload']. 'staffing' (33 files, staffing levels/ratios) and 'staffing-flexibility' (1 file, narrow OHV dental role config) are genuinely distinct — not merged.
aliasNotes.employment-support-officers: Verified 15 Aug 2026: both tags cover the same named Aboriginal/Disability/Veteran Employment Support Officer roles (Schedules 3G/3H/3I) — 'employment-support-officers' clause cross-references those same schedules. 'employee-support' (1 file, general FDV-leave employer support commitment) is unrelated — not merged.
aliasNotes.part-time: Verified 15 Aug 2026: co-tagged on the same file (31-dual-part-time-appointments.md). Merge direction follows the established casual→casual-employment precedent (short form aliases into the more specific/descriptive form).
aliasNotes.family-and-domestic-violence-leave: Verified 15 Aug 2026: NOT an EBA-vintage terminology split as originally hypothesized — 'family-violence-leave' (13 files) is applied even to clauses explicitly titled 'Family and Domestic Violence Leave' across multiple EBAs including the newest (mental-health, nurses-midwives, childrens-services). Same clause tagged inconsistently regardless of date.
aliasNotes.gender-affirmation: Verified 15 Aug 2026: all 3 files (has-managers-admin-2025-2027, mental-health, nurses-midwives) share near-identical verbatim clause text ('The Employer encourages a culture...gender affirmation refers to...'). No broader non-leave usage of 'gender-affirmation' found.
aliasNotes.rates/hourly-rates/wage-rates: Verified 15 Aug 2026: 'rates' shows 100% file overlap with 'pay-rates' everywhere observed; 'hourly-rates' (2 files) is a strict subset of the same pages; 'wage-rates' (2 files, has-managers-admin-2025-2027 wage-table schedules) is the same clause type as the equivalent archive pages tagged rates+pay-rates+wages, differing only by authorship date. 'wages' (78 files, broader payment/salary-packaging/super topic) and 'wage-increases' (1 file, negotiated pay-rise percentages specifically) are genuinely distinct — not merged.
aliasNotes.dispute-resolution: Verified 15 Aug 2026: 'disputes' (23 files) covers the same 'Dispute Resolution Procedure'/'Independent Dispute Resolution Panel' clause type across every EBA; the sole 'dispute-resolution' clause's own synonyms list literally includes 'disputes'.
aliasNotes.workplace-safety: Verified 15 Aug 2026: co-tagged with 'occupational-health-and-safety' (itself aliased to 'ohs') on the core general OHS clause, and its own synonyms list includes 'ohs'. 'health-and-safety-representatives' (2 files, HSR election/training/placement) is a genuinely distinct elected-role sub-topic — not merged. 'workplace-health-and-safety' (1 file, Worker Wellbeing Officer schedule, already primarily tagged worker-wellbeing/mental-health) is ambiguous — left in needsReview.
aliasNotes.time-off-in-lieu: Verified 15 Aug 2026: both tags used on clauses titled 'Overtime In Lieu' with verbatim-identical clause text (managers-admin/hours-of-work/7-overtime-in-lieu.md vs health-allied-services/hours-of-work/21-overtime-in-lieu.md). Canonical picked as 'overtime-in-lieu' since both source files literally use that slug.
aliasNotes.staff-appraisal: Verified 15 Aug 2026: co-tagged on the same file (24-staff-appraisal.md, topics include both 'staff-appraisal' and 'performance-appraisal').

needsReview.note: 'flexible-working-arrangements' resolved 15 Aug 2026 (merged into 'flexible-work' — see aliasNotes). Remaining: 'flexibility' (2 files, cross-role/ward rostering flexibility) is a distinct concept from the FWA-request clause type and should stay separate. 'flexible-working' (1 file, has-managers-admin-2025-2027 transition-to-retirement clause) loosely references a flexible arrangement as an implementation detail, not itself a FWA-request clause — thin sample, recommend manual retag of that one file to 'flexible-work' rather than a blanket alias.

'workload-management' resolved 15 Aug 2026 (merged into 'workload' — see aliasNotes). Remaining: 'staffing' (33 files, staffing levels/ratios/minimums, distinct from workload) and 'staffing-flexibility' (1 file, narrow OHV dental role config) confirmed genuinely distinct — do not merge into 'workload'.

Verified 15 Aug 2026: not a duplicate-tagging issue — 'paid-leave' is a single orphan tag (1 file, family-and-domestic-violence-leave clause) not used elsewhere for a paid/unpaid classification scheme. This is a data-quality question (extend 'paid-leave' to other clauses, or drop it) rather than a merge decision — do not alias into 'leave', that would lose the paid/unpaid semantic axis entirely if the tag is ever extended.

Verified 15 Aug 2026: 'education-and-training' (1 file, Workplace Trainer/Careers Advisor role schedule) is already co-tagged with 'workplace-training' and 'career-advice' on that same page, making it likely redundant with those two tags rather than a subset of 'education'. Leaning toward retag/drop rather than a cluster merge — needs a maintainer decision, not auto-merged.

Confirmed three-way ambiguity 15 Aug 2026: 'meal' co-occurs with BOTH 'meal-allowance' (payment, e.g. allowance schedules and overtime-meal clauses) and 'meal-breaks' (timing, e.g. the breaks clause) roughly evenly. A blind merge into either target would misclassify about half of its uses. Needs per-file retagging of 'meal' to whichever specific concept applies, not a bulk alias.

Verified 15 Aug 2026: original hypothesis (transition = retirement-related) was wrong, but conclusion holds — 'transition' (1 file) is about reclassification off a deprecated 'All Other Employees' code, 'transitional' (1 file) is an award savings/transitional-provisions schedule (FWC variation orders). Confirmed genuinely distinct concepts sharing only a word stem — do not merge.

Verified 15 Aug 2026: 'vehicle' (6 files) is genuinely broader — covers the allowance, rural 4WD/AWD vehicle provision, FBT on salary-packaged vehicles, and general travelling allowances — while 'vehicle-allowance' (1 file) targets only the specific allowance subclause. Confirmed not a simple duplicate; if resolved, prefer a file-level retag of the single 'vehicle-allowance' file to 'vehicle' over a systemic alias.

'workplace-safety' resolved 15 Aug 2026 (merged into 'ohs' — see aliasNotes). Remaining: 'health-and-safety-representatives' (2 files, HSR election/training/department-placement) confirmed a genuinely distinct elected-role sub-topic — not merged. 'workplace-health-and-safety' (1 file, Worker Wellbeing Officer schedule) is borderline — conceptually OHS-adjacent but the file's actual primary topic is already covered by 'worker-wellbeing'/'mental-health'; ambiguous enough to leave for a maintainer call rather than guess.

'rates'/'hourly-rates'/'wage-rates' resolved 15 Aug 2026 (merged into 'pay-rates' — see aliasNotes). Remaining: 'wages' (78 files, broad payment/salary-packaging/superannuation/higher-duties topic) and 'wage-increases' (1 file, negotiated pay-rise percentages specifically) confirmed genuinely distinct from the wage-rate-table concept — not merged. Note: leaving this stub entry mainly so a future audit doesn't re-flag 'wages' as unreviewed; no action needed unless new evidence surfaces.

NEW 15 Aug 2026: all three co-occur on one omnibus file (…/20-managing-conduct-and-performance.md). 'discipline' (16 files) and 'performance-management' are each used more broadly elsewhere and may be legitimately distinct concepts that happen to co-occur on this single page; 'conduct' (1 file) may be redundant. Needs the same per-file disambiguation treatment as the 'meal' cluster before any merge — do not bulk-merge.

NEW 15 Aug 2026: 'professional-development-leave' (1 file) is tagged only with 'education', not 'professional-development' — overlap with 'professional-development' itself is unverified. Needs a content check before any merge call.

NEW 15 Aug 2026: both broad payment-concept tags (7 and 14 files respectively) flagged for potential overlap with each other and with 'wages', not yet verified against clause content — follow-up pass needed.
NEW 15 Aug 2026: small allowance-adjacent tags (1-2 files each) that could plausibly overlap — not yet verified against clause content.
NEW 15 Aug 2026: 'redeployment' (1 file) may be treated as a redundancy sub-topic in some EBAs — not yet verified. Low file count on one side makes this low-risk to check in a future pass.

dataQualityFlags.note: RESOLVED (15 Aug 2026): confirmed each affected page also already carries 'salary-circular', so the specific number is supplementary, not the sole pointer to the concept. User chose to hyphenate rather than drop, preserving the distinct per-agreement circular number (each EBA cites a different one) since it may carry legal significance. Fixed directly in source .md frontmatter across all 8 affected pages ('circular 870' → 'circular-870', etc.) — not an alias, a formatting typo fix.

RESOLVED (15 Aug 2026): verified legitimate, not a tagging mistake. All 4 occurrences are in has-managers-admin-2025-2027, whose agreement structure has literal named 'Section 2' (Health & Allied Services) and 'Section 3' (Managers & Admin) divisions — confirmed by clause slugs/paths ('1-application-of-section-2.md' under health-allied-services/preliminary, '1-application-of-section-3.md' under managers-admin/preliminary). No fix needed; kept here as a record so this isn't re-flagged as suspicious in a future audit.
